# NavigationAgent

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("NavigationAgent")`

Walks its part to a point over the walkable ground, keeping clear of the other agents as it goes -- a crowd (ADR 0098). The engine moves the part on the simulation clock: set `Target`, and `Reached` fires when it arrives. For one character a script walking `FindPath`'s waypoints is enough; this is for many that must not walk through each other.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Active` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether it is walking. Writing `Target` sets it; arriving clears it. |
| `AgentType` | `string` | `""` | read/write | Which agent it is, as `NavigationService:DefineAgent` named it; empty for the service's own. |
| `MaxSpeed` | `number` | `8` | read/write | Its fastest, in metres per second. |
| `Target` | `vector` | — | read/write | Where it is going. Writing it starts the walk; while `Active` is false it stands still. |

## Events

Every signal here is **deferred** (ADR 0015): a handler runs at the next
drain point, never inside the call that fired it.

### `Reached()`

Fired once when it arrives at `Target`.
